**OpenAI is an artificial intelligence (AI) research and technology company that created ChatGPT — the AI assistant you're talking to right now.** Its goal is to develop AI that benefits people and society. [openai.com](https://openai.com/about/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What does OpenAI do?

![Seperti Apa Tampilan Ikon Aplikasi iOS Resmi ChatGPT? | OpenAI Help Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/d9mnrtJpSff4Kqg4hGh7Xpjp8Us3qsDreLzpt4ReDzFm1VfHhsPd4624tr5z3E961C9fZZ1ExpSmy_I1KZ_4MQOnOJG9tbccgWe60d7m3kQuquaY8Q8AEC3WL5MDKFqyXPbs1KVuukTtAKnCJnOBc803I8ThskkatiezrMNfUIH4IsM7anlxuhkR695bhFXt?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Creates AI assistants**

OpenAI develops ChatGPT, which can answer questions, explain difficult topics, help with homework, write emails, brainstorm ideas, and assist with coding.

---

![How OpenAI is building its moat](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qrpUvbOEs27pMulzx7QjlCUnNrAbBd7gb1g6UaLOahgjVXHDzgr1s5Zy87bHHh1AI8E1f7Y469nTLMVaD7dTbgUS4uk9aiUisz0YJV8eRZriuFvQIQu38WOGO-B0bkzMy_AP7o_DEE2VPeqxUphLVJGpMXImxIzSun051M_JT3UBMAAsTV8tv6ZYGi3wCkkf?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Researches artificial intelligence**

OpenAI trains AI models to understand and generate language, reason through problems, analyze information, and help people complete tasks.

---

![Databricks, Palantir forge strategic partnership to enhance AI integration | Mi3](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v0-LVHxL3x1bCXS0e7W2LsP6rhP9poH_0lHgbeRXen1kdHTNvBInaTrznbJPlcaheA8Msi-KLVuSK4r3AHHUddP5Xkm-za1Jza8nXWeD9qu8SNufXX-yvYfJL9OtlRABHDf8ExlME4-lTXLBiQDmtgP1oyEjjI4Sdpi781Uhx002GbLwoov5vSnuwNXxDaEQ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Develops creative tools**

Its technology can help people create images, work with audio, analyze files, write computer programs, and develop new applications. [help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12677804-what-is-chatgpt-faq?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[developers.openai.com](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/concepts?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Who owns OpenAI?

OpenAI was founded in 2015. Its current organizational structure includes two connected parts: the nonprofit OpenAI Foundation and the for-profit OpenAI Group, which operates as a public benefit corporation. [openai.com](https://openai.com/about/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What is the difference between OpenAI and ChatGPT?

Think of it this way\:

- **OpenAI** is the organization that develops the technology.
- **ChatGPT** is one of the products you can use.
- **GPT models** are the underlying AI systems that power ChatGPT and other applications.

## How does OpenAI make a difference in everyday life?

People use OpenAI's technology to learn new skills, save time at work, solve problems, explore ideas, and make creative projects easier.

One important thing to remember: **AI isn't perfect.** It can sometimes make mistakes or give misleading answers, so important information should be verified.

You can learn more on the official website: [OpenAI.com](https://openai.com/)\.
